items.reason: File is DarkModeColor.Theme.StyleSheet.swift. Path is joined with URL(fileURLWithPath:isDirectory:).appendingPathComponent. Test writes into a temp directory without a trailing slash. Package.swift: CSS Tests now depends on the CSS Theming Foundation Integration target (needed for the test).
Removed the 'margin: 0px X' branch; equal left/right now fall through to margin-left/margin-right. Rendering test in new Tests/CSS Tests/Margin Tests.swift.

Signatures kept (non-failing) to avoid breaking theme definitions. Forms without known channels now return color-mix(in srgb, color, transparent|white|black N%), which CSS resolves to the intended result (the same arithmetic the rgb path does); the brightness fraction is clamped to -1...1 (1 = white, -1 = black) like opacity already clamps alpha. Documented on both methods; tests in new Tests/CSS Tests/Color.Value Tests.swift.

api_changes: Behaviour only: Color.Value.opacity/adjustBrightness/lighter/darker return .mix(...) instead of self for hwb/lab/lch/oklab/oklch/mix/system/currentColor/transparent, unparseable hex and named colors outside the basic 16; adjustBrightness with |percent| > 1 clamps instead of returning self.
notes: Package.swift (committed manifest) changed: test target dependency added.
